title: Corefall
description: CoreFall is a powerful Minecraft plugin that introduces a unique Core System
body:
🌀 CoreFall – Ultimate RPG Core Plugin for Minecraft
CoreFall redefines Minecraft PvP and survival by introducing powerful Cores—each with unique passives, abilities, and drawbacks. Gain XP from kills and upgrade your core to Tier 2 and 3, unlocking greater strength and strategic depth.

🔥 **Wrath Core:**

🟢 **Passive:** Strength II

⚡**Ability:** Leap (Cooldown: 10s)

🔴 **Drawback:** Cannot use shields


⏳ **Chrono Core:**

🟢 **Passive: **Speed II

⚡ **Ability:** Time Freeze (Cooldown: 8s)

🔴 **Drawback:** Slower mining


🌑 **Abyss Core:**

🟢 **Passive:** Invisibility

⚡** Ability:** Dark Blast (Cooldown: 12s)

🔴 **Drawback:** Weakened in sunlight


🛡️ **Guardian Core:**

🟢 **Passive:** Resistance I

⚡** Ability:** Shield Wall (Cooldown: 15s)

🔴 **Drawback:** Reduced mobility


🌿** Nature Core:**

🟢 **Passive:** Regeneration I

⚡** Ability: **Root Bind (Cooldown: 10s)

🔴** Drawback:** Weaker attack strength


⚡** Storm Core:**

🟢 **Passive**: Jump Boost II

⚡ **Ability**: Lightning Dash (Cooldown: 7s)

🔴 **Drawback**: Lower defense


🧠** Upgrade Mechanics:**

**Earn 200 XP per kill**

**Tier 2 Upgrade**: 500 XP

**Tier 3 Upgrade**: 1500 XP
Each tier boosts your core's passive effects or improves its ability’s performance.

**⚙️ Installation Instructions**
  Download the latest CoreFall .jar file
  
  Place it in your server’s /plugins directory
  
  Restart or reload your server
  
  Edit config.yml to customize core abilities and XP
  
  Jump in and start playing with epic abilities!

💡 **Features**
Fully configurable via config.yml

Works on most Spigot/Paper servers

Adds RPG-style gameplay to your Minecraft world

Perfect for competitive, RPG, or minigame servers

Built-in upgrade GUI and XP system
